_comment: Optional business hints for this database. The agent works without this file: it discovers tables, columns, joins, categorical values and ranges from DuckDB itself. Add synonyms and definitions here instead of code.

definitions.text: Active vulnerabilities have status Open. Count distinct server_id when counting servers across many findings.
Backups are run history (many per server). Latest per server: row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY server_id ORDER BY started_at DESC, backup_id DESC) = 1.
Incident priority P1 is highest priority. Severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low) is a separate attribute from priority.
Unsupported OS means servers.support_status = 'Unsupported'. Percentages use all servers in the requested group as denominator.
Estate is applications.estate_id joined to estates.estate_id (servers -> applications -> estates), not the server environment.
Recent means the last 30 days before the reference date unless specified.
Risk can be measured with open Critical/High vulnerabilities, incidents, or evergreening risk_level; state which measure was used.
